title: Give each league an identity
question: Compare the three Compete layouts. These are illustrative design studies; choose what should carry forward.

options.label: League banner
options.thesis: A league’s photo or two-color emblem opens its own compact season panel.
options.viewport: A compact masthead, an image-bearing league, a league without a photo, and the beginning of the next.
options.risk: The largest identity treatment; compare its height carefully against the other two.

options.label: Club spread
options.thesis: A photo or emblem sits alongside the name, with friends and the season underneath.
options.viewport: Two complete leagues and part of a third, with a consistent text measure beneath the identity.
options.risk: A long name must reflow beside the inset without making the row feel crowded.

options.label: Club index
options.thesis: A small identifying image anchors each league, leaving more room for people and a readable standing.
options.viewport: Three recognizable league entries with photos and photo-free marks sharing the same layout.
options.risk: The most compact option; its identity mark has to carry enough character.
